---
title: "MSD QC Report"
format:
  html:
    df-print: paged
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  ab:                null
  plate:             null
  s1_raw_path:       null
  s2_raw_path:       null
  s3_processed_path: null
  data_path:         null
  user_id:           null
  analyzed_on:       null
  experiment_name:   "N/A"
  experiment_date:   "N/A"
---

```{r setup}
# Setup & helpers ----

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(htmltools)
})

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || (is.character(x) && !nzchar(x))) y else x
}

safe_read <- function(p) {
  if (is.null(p) || !nzchar(p)) return(NULL)
  p <- normalizePath(p, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(readRDS(p), error = function(e) NULL)
}

# Standard table renderer - returns an HTML kable or a "not available" notice
kblx <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 3, align = "l", ...) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(HTML("<p><em>Not available.</em></p>"))
  }
  knitr::kable(
    df,
    format  = "html",
    caption = caption,
    digits  = digits,
    align   = align,
    ...
  ) |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
      full_width        = FALSE
    )
}


# Load RDS inputs ----

s1_raw       <- safe_read(params$s1_raw_path)
s2_raw       <- safe_read(params$s2_raw_path)
s3_processed <- safe_read(params$s3_processed_path)
tables       <- safe_read(params$data_path)


# Pull individual QC tables ----

table_names <- if (is.list(tables) && length(tables) > 0) tolower(names(tables)) else character(0)

pull_table <- function(nm) {
  idx <- which(table_names == tolower(nm))
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)
  tables[[idx[1]]]
}

tbl_controls  <- pull_table("controls")
tbl_standards <- pull_table("standards")
tbl_unknowns  <- pull_table("unknowns")
tbl_qc        <- pull_table("qc")
```

**Experiment:** `r params$experiment_name %||% "N/A"`  
**Date:** `r params$experiment_date %||% "N/A"`  
**Plate:** `r params$plate %||% "N/A"`  
**User:** `r params$user_id %||% "N/A"`  
**Generated:** `r format(Sys.time(), "%d %b %Y, %I:%M:%S %p")`

---

## Plate-Level QC Summary

```{r qc-badge, results='asis'}
# Render a coloured PASS / REPEAT badge ----

badge <- function(text, cls) {
  HTML(sprintf(
    '<span class="badge bg-%s" style="font-size:1rem; padding:.5em 1em;">%s</span>',
    cls, text
  ))
}

if (is.data.frame(tbl_qc) && nrow(tbl_qc) > 0) {
  # Column is named Plate_QC (set by DataTableFunc)
  qc_value <- toupper(as.character(tbl_qc$Plate_QC[1]))
  if      (qc_value == "PASS")   cat(as.character(badge("PASS",   "success")))
  else if (qc_value == "REPEAT") cat(as.character(badge("REPEAT", "danger")))
  else                           cat(as.character(badge("N/A",    "secondary")))
} else {
  cat(as.character(HTML("<p><em>QC table not provided.</em></p>")))
}
```

---

## Experiment Metadata (Section 1)

```{r section-1, results='asis'}
# Display s1_raw - experiment-level info (name, date, user, plate type) ----

if (is.data.frame(s1_raw) && nrow(s1_raw) > 0) {
  kblx(s1_raw)
} else {
  HTML("<p><em>No experiment metadata available (s1_raw missing or empty).</em></p>")
}
```

## Controls

```{r controls, results='asis'}
# Controls table (negative + positive) with Analyte_QC and Sample_QC ----

df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(tbl_controls), error = function(e) NULL)

if (is.data.frame(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
  kblx(df, caption = "Controls")
} else {
  HTML("<p><em>No data in Controls table.</em></p>")
}
```
